hypothesis: v3 failed because general-purpose CLIP (ground-level photos) does not read overhead imagery. A CLIP fine-tuned on remote-sensing image-text pairs (RemoteCLIP) inside the same LangSplat SAM + CLIP step may classify the authors' higher-quality model's views.
independence: Fixed before any v4 score. Not blind: chosen after v3's failure. Changes from v3, all decided from v3's failure mode only: remote-sensing CLIP; prompts in remote-sensing caption style; the 'shadow' and 'car' classes removed ('shadow' absorbed 93% of v3 cells); 'pavement' becomes 'parking lot'. Rules, thresholds, fusion, mapping and targets are v3's.
grid: DFC2019 JAX_068 truth grid (UTM 17N, 0.5 m, 512 x 512), as in v1/v2
surface: as v3 (pipeline.semantics.top_surface) from the authors' model's rendered depth (artifacts/skyfall/JAX_068/final-depth/depth-points.npz)
placement: the authors' model is only visually placed; its measured horizontal offset from lidar (artifacts/skyfall/JAX_068/lidar-authors/dsm-validation.json: east -1 m, north +2 m) is removed before gridding, projection and splat assignment. Horizontal only; the vertical offset does not affect height above ground.

features.tool: LangSplat preprocess.py, SAM ViT-B as v3, with --clip_model ViT-L-14 --clip_pretrained ckpts/remoteclip/RemoteCLIP-ViT-L-14.pt --clip_dims 768
features.views: the 17 training views of the authors' JAX_068 dataset (transforms_train.json), each cropped to the truth grid plus 48 px at native resolution by scripts/crop-scene-to-grid.py (principal point adjusted); the 2 test views are not used

building: a satellite image of building roofs
an aerial view of a building
tree: an aerial view of a tree canopy
grass: a satellite image of a grass lawn
a grassy field seen from above
road: a satellite image of a road
an aerial view of a street
an asphalt road seen from above
parking: a satellite image of a parking lot
an aerial view of a parking lot
a paved parking area seen from above
soil: a satellite image of bare soil
an aerial view of bare land
sand and dirt seen from above
water: an aerial view of a pond

scoring.prototype: mean of the L2-normalised CLIP text embeddings of a class's three prompts, renormalised
scoring.segment: softmax over the nine classes of 100 x cosine(segment feature, prototype)
scoring.cell: each cell's top-surface point (gap-filled height) projected through each training camera (bundle-adjusted pinhole, deskewed image); nearest pixel at mask resolution; median over visible views, then argmax
scoring.visibility: inside the image, inside the deskew coverage mask, covered by a segment, and not occluded: camera depth <= minimum depth of all top-surface points in the 3 x 3 pixel neighbourhood + 1.0 m

rules: building -> building if hag >= 2.5 m, else ground
road -> road if hag < 2.5 m, else unknown
parking, soil -> ground if hag < 2.5 m, else unknown
water -> water if hag < 2.5 m, else unknown
no top surface or fewer than 2 visible views -> unknown
classes.clip_only_diagnostic: same argmax without height: building, vegetation, grass, road, ground (parking, soil), water

splats: as v1/v2 (pipeline.semantics.splat_classes); the wall rule uses cells classified building instead of OSM footprints

evaluation.scored_cells: truth not 65 and not 17; geometry as built (no registration shift)
evaluation.strict: our unknown cells count as incorrect
evaluation.headline: the height rules above; the CLIP-only variant is reported as a diagnostic and cannot pass

rule: Prompts, weights, fusion, rules and targets are fixed before any v4 comparison with DFC2019 and are not changed afterwards.
